With ill-judged parsimony, the Emperor Michael had disbanded the militia, who guarded the passes of Mount Olympus, and had thus left Bithynia open to attack. Orchan, the son of Othman, took advantage of these favourable occurrences, enlarged his territory at the expense of the Greeks, and by uniting several of the scattered Turkish tribes under one head, laid the foundation of the Ottoman Empire.

arxiv-2104-08801.title: Back-Training excels Self-Training at Unsupervised Domain Adaptation of Question Generation and Passage Retrieval
arxiv-2104-08801.creator: Devang Kulshreshtha, Robert Belfer, Iulian Vlad Serban, Siva Reddy
arxiv-2104-08801.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce back-training, an alternative to self-training for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) from source to target domain. While self-training generates synthetic training data where natural inputs are aligned with noisy outputs, back-training results in natural outputs aligned with noisy inputs.

arxiv-2208-01719.title: Streaming Reconstruction from Non-uniform Samples
arxiv-2208-01719.creator: Justin Romberg
arxiv-2208-01719.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Justin Romberg. We present an online algorithm for reconstructing a signal from a set of non-uniform samples. By representing the signal using compactly supported basis functions, we show how estimating the expansion coefficients using least-squares can be implemented in a streaming manner: as batches of samples over subsequent time intervals are presented, the algorithm forms an initial estimate of the signal over the sampling interval then updates its estimates over previous intervals.

arxiv-2209-06856.title: The virial theorem for non-differentiable dynamical paths in resolution-scale relativity
arxiv-2209-06856.creator: Tugdual LeBohec
arxiv-2209-06856.description: Abstract The virial theorem is established in the framework of resolution-scale relativity for stochastic dynamics characterized by a diffusion constant 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . It only relies on a simple time average just like the classical virial theorem, while the quantum mechanical virial theorem involves the expectation values of the observables.

arxiv-2210-10620.title: Active Image Indexing
arxiv-2210-10620.creator: Pierre Fernandez, Matthijs Douze, Hervé Jégou, Teddy Furon
arxiv-2210-10620.description: Abstract Image copy detection and retrieval from large databases leverage two components. First, a neural network maps an image to a vector representation, that is relatively robust to various transformations of the image. Second, an efficient but approximate similarity search algorithm trades scalability (size and speed) against quality of the search, thereby introducing a source of error.

arxiv-2302-03725.title: WaveTrain: A Python package for numerical quantum mechanics of chain-like systems based on tensor trains
arxiv-2302-03725.creator: Jerome Riedel, Patrick Gelß, Rupert Klein, Burkhard Schmidt
arxiv-2302-03725.description: Abstract WaveTrain is an open-source software for numerical simulations of chain-like quantum systems with nearest-neighbor (NN) interactions only. The Python package is centered around tensor train (TT, or matrix product) format representations of Hamiltonian operators and (stationary or time-evolving) state vectors.

arxiv-2307-12515.title: Impact of 3D Antenna Radiation Pattern in UAV Air-to-Ground Path Loss Modeling and RSRP-based Localization in Rural Area Thanks: This research is supported in part by the NSF award CNS-1939334. The data and the Matlab scripts for generating the results in this manuscript are available at [ 1 ] . Tha
arxiv-2307-12515.creator: Sung Joon Maeng, Hyeokjun Kwon, Ozgur Ozdemir, Member, IEEE , AND İsmail Güvenç, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2307-12515.description: Abstract Ensuring reliable and seamless wireless connectivity for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has emerged as a critical requirement for a wide range of applications. The increasing deployment of UAVs has increased the significance of cellular-connected UAVs (C-UAVs) in enabling beyond-visual line of sight (BVLOS) communications.

arxiv-2502-08414.title: Inverse Covariance and Partial Correlation Matrix Estimation via Joint Partial Regression
arxiv-2502-08414.creator: Samuel Erickson, Tobias Rydén
arxiv-2502-08414.description: Abstract We present a method for estimating sparse high-dimensional inverse covariance and partial correlation matrices, which exploits the connection between the inverse covariance matrix and linear regression. The method is a two-stage estimation method wherein each individual feature is regressed on all other features while positive semi-definiteness is enforced simultaneously.

arxiv-2503-13305.title: Computation Mechanism Behind LLM Position Generalization
arxiv-2503-13305.creator: Chi Han, Heng Ji
arxiv-2503-13305.description: Abstract Most written natural languages are composed of sequences of words and sentences. Similar to humans, large language models (LLMs) exhibit flexibility in handling textual positions - a phenomenon we term position generalization . They can understand texts with position perturbations and generalize to longer texts than those encountered during training with the latest techniques.

pmc-11393310.title: Investigation of dynamic effect of rapid impact compaction
pmc-11393310.creator: Jozef Vlček, Filip Gago, Ján Mihálik, František Malík, František Bahleda, Jozef Prokop, Martin Štefánik
pmc-11393310.description: Dynamic compaction is a soil improvement technique which involves the repeated application of an impact load to a contact area of the soil surface induced by heavy weights. Experimental measurements were prepared for evaluation of the ground wave propagation induced by the rapid impact compaction. Influence of increase of subsoil stiffness during compaction and terrain configuration were investigated.

pmc-12608000.title: Urolithin A Alleviates Doxorubicin-Induced Senescence in Mesenchymal Stem Cells
pmc-12608000.creator: Alexander Kalinin, Ekaterina Zubkova, Mikhail Menshikov, Yelena Parfyonova, Mirella Falconi, Gabriella Teti
pmc-12608000.description: The accumulation of senescent cells, characterized by a pro-inflammatory secretory phenotype (SASP), metabolic dysfunction, and irreversible cell cycle arrest, is a driving force behind numerous age-related pathologies and directly undermines the therapeutic potential of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). In this study, we explore the senotherapeutic potential of urolithin A, a renowned antioxidant compound, in human adipose-derived MSCs (AD-hMSCs).

pmc-12641999.title: Temporal Trends, Multiple Residue Incidence, and Chronic Health Risk of Pesticides in Egyptian Onions: A Four-Year Market Surveillance
pmc-12641999.creator: Farag Malhat, Shokr Shokr, Sara Heikal, Nour El-Hoda Zidan, Teresa D’Amore
pmc-12641999.description: This study analyzed 5731 Egyptian onion samples collected from 2021 to 2024 to detect 430 pesticide residues and evaluate occurrence patterns, EU Maximum Residue Limits (MRLs) compliance, multiple residue prevalence, and consumer health implications. The analysis revealed temporal fluctuations in contamination, with residue-free samples ranging from 51.19% (2023) to 75.59% (2022) and MRL exceedances varying from 1.34% (2022) to 8.

pmc-13094891.title: The effects of mindfulness-based interventions on mothers’ stress reduction and breastfeeding self-efficacy: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-13094891.creator: Noosha Farzaei, Sepideh Hajian, Kiarash Saatchi, Mehdi Khabazkhoob
pmc-13094891.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). :In spite of the crucial role of breast milk for infant growth and immune development, the initiation of breastfeeding immediately after birth and the continuation of exclusive breastfeeding have declined. This issue is often attributed to several factors including maternal concerns due to competency to breastfeed and sufficiency of her breast milk that affect her perceived self-efficacy to initiate and continue breast feeding.

pmc-13197149.title: Nobiletin from Xiaoyu Xiezhuo Decoction: Restoring Mitochondrial Dynamics and Alleviating Renal Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury via M1 Macrophage Modulation
pmc-13197149.creator: Yuan Yuan, Jing Huang, Yinchao Zhou, Zhibo Weng, Yiru Weng, Zhouzhou Dong
pmc-13197149.description: IntroductionThere have been reports that the traditional Chinese medicine formula Xiaoyu Xiezhuo Decoction (XYXZD) protects against kidney injury. Its possible mechanisms in renal ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) remain unclear, though. Investigating XYXZD’s function and possible therapeutic effects on renal IRI is the goal of this investigation.

pmc-13364866.title: Blastocystis, an Enigmatic Parasite
pmc-13364866.creator: José Cebrián-Carmona, José Antonio Garrido-Cárdenas, Concepción Mesa-Valle
pmc-13364866.description: Blastocystis spp. is the most prevalent human enteric protist, yet its clinical significance remains controversial. Currently recognized as a genetically diverse stramenopile with zoonotic potential, it comprises at least 42 subtypes, of which ST1–ST4 account for most human infections. Despite more than a century of research, its pathogenic role and ecological interactions are still debated.

pmc-13417199.title: Total Synthesis and Biological Evaluation of Exiguamines
pmc-13417199.creator: Seungjoo Noh, Jisook Park, Yeehwan Kim, Venkat R. Krishnamurthy, Chang-Ki Min, Eun Young Choi, Chulbom Lee
pmc-13417199.description: A concise and divergent total synthesis of the marine indoloquinone natural product exiguamine has been accomplished. The synthetic strategy relies on a hydantoin linchpin approach that unites the tryptamine- and dopamine-derived subunits, setting the stage for efficient construction of the core framework.

pmc-13453146.title: Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG)-Associated Secondary Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Mimicking Sepsis and Multiorgan Dysfunction: A Case Report
pmc-13453146.creator: Ajay Chauhan, Kapil Sharma, Aparna Valsan, Prajwal Gowda, Sumita Sharma
pmc-13453146.description: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a life-threatening hyperinflammatory syndrome. It can closely mimic severe sepsis and multiorgan dysfunction. Intravesical bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG), used for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, is rarely associated with systemic infection or immune-mediated complications. We report a 50-year-old man who developed high-grade fever and progressive jaundice shortly after intravesical BCG therapy.

pmc-13454020.title: Clinicopathological features and impact on surgical axillary management of encapsulated papillary carcinoma of the breast
pmc-13454020.creator: Yasmine Hany Abdel Moamen Elzohery, Ahmed Orabi, Galal Ghaly, Neveen Gamal Fathy Ali, Eman Ali Khalaf, Hazem Abdelazim, Sherif Nasser Taha, Mohamed Fathy Abdelfattah Abdelrahman Elithy
pmc-13454020.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEncapsulated papillary carcinoma (EPC) is a rare breast malignancy accounting for approximately 0.5–1% of all breast cancers. Although generally associated with favorable outcomes, the presence of invasive carcinoma may influence axillary nodal involvement, treatment decisions, and prognosis.ObjectiveTo evaluate the clinicopathological and imaging characteristics of EPC, assess the frequency of associated invasive disease and axillary lymph node involvement, and determine their impact on surgical axillary management and oncological outcomes.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included all consecutive patients diagnosed with EPC and treated surgically at

pmc-13640980.title: Synaptic Organization of the Primate Retina: Toward a Human Foveal Connectome
pmc-13640980.creator: Yeon Jin Kim, Dennis M. Dacey
pmc-13640980.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The great diversity of retinal cell types across mammalian species, including humans, is well recognized. Recent transcriptomic profiling has not only confirmed this diversity but also identified homologous cell types across species, revealing molecular conservation of cell type identity. Yet retinal circuits are functionally specialized for distinct visual behaviors across species, raising a key question: If cell types are conserved, then what drives this functional specialization?

pmc-13663561.title: Longitudinal Changes in Testicular Volume and the Additional Value of Body Weight for Estimating Histology-Linked Testicular Development in Male Cynomolgus Macaques (Macaca fascicularis)
pmc-13663561.creator: Ryosuke Kawashima, Hirofumi Matsumoto, Atsushi Asano
pmc-13663561.description: Simple SummaryMale cynomolgus macaques are widely used in nonclinical safety studies in which reliable evaluation of the male reproductive system may be required. Chronological age is readily available when animals are selected for studies, but animals of similar age can differ markedly in testicular development.

pmc-13685648.title: Aquaporin 5 and Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-Related Factor 2 Upregulation in Tumor and Stroma Is Associated with Poor Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Breast Cancer
pmc-13685648.creator: Ilija Guteša, Sanda Bubanović, Tonči Vodopić, Monika Mlinarić, Krešimir Grgat, Ana Čipak Gašparović
pmc-13685648.description: ObjectiveBreast cancer remains a leading cause of global mortality in women, with therapy resistance posing a major challenge to successful treatment. Chemotherapy-induced oxidative stress can trigger adaptive survival mechanisms through the antioxidative transcription factor NRF2 and membrane pores known as peroxiporins.
